title: Cosmic Ascendant — Weight of the Stars
revision: Draft 1 / Cosmic Ascendant classification / forked tree

classification.applies_to: existing supported tags of every Cosmic Ascendant jutsu

emphasis.primary: Exposure into burst: Increase Damage Taken (2 rows, +5 ceiling) feeding Cosmic Explosion Damage (1 row, +6 ceiling)
emphasis.secondary: Decrease Damage Taken (Defensive; 3 rows on Cosmic Chains, Cosmic Energy and Cosmic Aura; +7 ceiling)
emphasis.tertiary: Cosmic Intent's Afterburn (+10 ceiling) and Lifesteal (+8 ceiling) as rival capstones; Increase Damage Given (+5) and Decrease Damage Given (+5) as glue
emphasis.rationale: Cosmic Ascendant is a rank S kit tagged Burst and Defensive with 10 supported rows on five jutsu. Its only Damage row is Cosmic Explosion (50 at level 25, 60 AP), so burst here is exposure first: Cosmic Intent and Cosmic Chains each carry a 35% Increase Damage Taken row that lists all four stat types with no element and therefore amplifies essentially every hit the target takes. Decrease Damage Taken sits on three separate 40 AP jutsu (Chains 35%, Energy 35%, Aura 30%, all 2 rounds on a 7-round cooldown), which is the broadest tag in the kit and the Defensive trait's engine. Cosmic Intent is the signature A-rank cast (IDT 35%, Afterburn 35%, Lifesteal 40% in one 40 AP action), so its burn and its leech are offered as two rival capstones a player cannot own together.

nodes.name: Celestial Alignment
nodes.flavor: When the stars fall into line, the enemy is laid bare and the ascendant burns brighter.
nodes.coverage_note: IDT 35% -> 37% on Cosmic Intent and Cosmic Chains (enemy, 2 rounds, 40 AP); IDG 35% -> 37% on Cosmic Energy (self, inside its circle).

nodes.name: Collapsing Star
nodes.flavor: A star does not go quietly. It folds inward, and the folding is the first blow.
nodes.coverage_note: Damage on Cosmic Explosion 50 -> 53 (60 AP, range 4, single target); its Wound row is unsupported and unchanged.

nodes.name: Supernova Unbound
nodes.flavor: What was held inside the star is held no longer.
nodes.coverage_note: Cosmic Explosion 50 -> 56 on the route; IDT on Cosmic Intent and Cosmic Chains 35% -> 40% with Celestial Alignment.

nodes.name: Searing Starlight
nodes.flavor: Starlight is old fire. It keeps burning long after it has arrived.
nodes.coverage_note: Cosmic Intent row 1 Afterburn 35% -> 38% (enemy, 2 rounds, 40 AP, range 5); every non-pierce hit that target takes feeds it.

nodes.name: Light of Dead Stars
nodes.flavor: The star is gone. Its light still reaches you, and it still burns.
nodes.coverage_note: Cosmic Intent Afterburn 35% -> 45% on the route (60% per-hit cap); IDT on Intent and Chains 35% -> 40% with Celestial Alignment.

nodes.name: Gravity Well
nodes.flavor: Everything thrown at the ascendant bends, slows, and arrives lighter than it left.
nodes.coverage_note: DDT 35% -> 37% on Cosmic Chains and Cosmic Energy, 30% -> 32% on Cosmic Aura (self, 2 rounds); DDG on Aura 30% -> 32% (enemy).

nodes.name: Event Horizon
nodes.flavor: Past this line, nothing reaches the center whole.
nodes.coverage_note: DDT on Chains and Energy 35% -> 39%, Aura 30% -> 34% with Gravity Well; Energy only while standing in its circle, from the next round.

nodes.name: Heart of the Singularity
nodes.flavor: At the center nothing escapes, and everything that falls in becomes more force.
nodes.coverage_note: DDT on Chains and Energy 35% -> 42%, Aura 30% -> 37% on the route; IDG on Cosmic Energy 35% -> 40% with Celestial Alignment.

nodes.name: Stellar Siphon
nodes.flavor: The ascendant drinks the light it tears loose.
nodes.coverage_note: Cosmic Intent row 2 Lifesteal 40% -> 43% (self, 2 rounds, 40 AP); shares the 60% leech cap with vamp; pierce hits count.

nodes.name: Hunger of the Void
nodes.flavor: The void is not empty. It is hungry, and it is patient.
nodes.coverage_note: Cosmic Intent Lifesteal 40% -> 48% on the route (60% cap shared with vamp); DDG on Cosmic Aura 30% -> 35% with Gravity Well.

examples.name: Supernova Unbound
examples.rationale: Damage +6 takes Cosmic Explosion from 50 to 56 (60 AP, the kit's only damage row) and Celestial Alignment plus the capstone's +3 put Increase Damage Taken on Cosmic Intent and Cosmic Chains at 40%, so the Explosion lands into a target exposed by either 40 AP opener; the bloodline's own IDG passive (25% + 0.15/level across Earth, Fire, Lightning, None and Wind) multiplies that raw power downstream. Gravity Well is the fourth purchase for 2% DDT on three rows and 2% DDG. It is the pure burst option and leaves the burn at 35%, the leech at 40% and mitigation at its lowest.

examples.name: Light of Dead Stars
examples.rationale: Cosmic Intent's Afterburn goes from 35% to 45% for its two rounds, so every non-pierce hit the burning target takes (Cosmic Explosion, weapons, normal jutsu, allies) carries up to 45% extra inside the 60% per-hit cap, and the capstone's +3 IDT with Celestial Alignment takes Intent's and Chains' exposure to 40% as well. Gravity Well rounds it out with 2% DDT and 2% DDG. This is single-target pressure that follows the one enemy Intent struck; Explosion's raw power and the leech are untouched.

examples.name: Heart of the Singularity
examples.rationale: Decrease Damage Taken +7 lifts Cosmic Chains and Cosmic Energy from 35% to 42% and Cosmic Aura from 30% to 37%, three separate 40 AP casts on 7-round cooldowns that can be rotated for near-continuous mitigation, and the capstone's +3 IDG with Celestial Alignment makes Energy's circle a 40% damage buff as well as a 42% guard while you stand in it. It is the tank who hits back from its own ground: Explosion stays at 50, Afterburn at 35% and Lifesteal at 40%, so it is clearly neither the burst nor the sustain build.

examples.name: Hunger of the Void
examples.rationale: The leech route takes Cosmic Intent's Lifesteal from 40% to 48%, twelve points under the 60% cap shared with vamp, and draws from every damage instance the caster lands during its two rounds, pierce included, while the capstone's +3 DDG with Gravity Well dulls the struck enemy's own blows to 35%. Celestial Alignment adds 2% exposure and 2% IDG for the fourth purchase. The alternative fourth, Event Horizon instead of Celestial Alignment, is the tank-siphon variant (DDT 39%/34%, DDG 35%, no exposure).

design_notes: Node split: two Foundations each fork into two Hidden -> Advanced routes. Celestial Alignment (IDT on Intent and Chains, IDG on Energy) opens the Damage route (Collapsing Star -> Supernova Unbound) and the Afterburn route (Searing Starlight -> Light of Dead Stars); Gravity Well (DDT on Chains, Energy, Aura; DDG on Aura) opens the DDT route (Event Horizon -> Heart of the Singularity) and the Lifesteal route (Stellar Siphon -> Hunger of the Void). IDG and DDG sit only on Foundations and capstones.

Calibration: single-row Damage is 3/3 (+6, the guardrail) because Cosmic Explosion is the kit's only damage row and the route reaches one jutsu where Taiyo's +5 reaches three (per-row +12% against +10-12.5%). Three-row DDT is 2/2/3 (+7) against Taiyo's single-row +10; two-row IDT tops out at +5 (Foundation +2 plus one capstone +3), under the two-row +7 lesson. Afterburn is 3/7 (+10) and Lifesteal 3/5 (+8, 48%). Row-weighted strongest build is 32 (01+06+07+08) on 10 rows against Taiyo's 31 on 9.

Passives and main tree: the bloodline IDG passive (25% + 0.15/level on Earth, Fire, Lightning, None, Wind; Highest) multiplies the enhanced Explosion downstream. Both IDT rows and the IDG row list all four stat types with no element, so they match every element-less hit and elemental hits of any listed stat type: the exposure amplifies allies', weapon and normal-jutsu damage on that enemy; Energy's IDG raises the caster's normal jutsu in the circle. Lifesteal includes pierce; other tags skip it.

Delivery and uptime: all five jutsu have a 7-round cooldown and cost 40 AP except Cosmic Explosion (60 AP, range 4). Every buff and debuff row lasts 2 rounds. Cosmic Energy is an EMPTY_GROUND circle: its IDG and DDT reach the caster from the round after the spawn and only while standing on its tiles (its move row sorts last). Intent has range 5, Chains and Aura 4. Three DDT rows on three casts allow a Chains -> Energy -> Aura rotation for near-continuous mitigation. Ranked modes skip skills.

Fourth-purchase choices: after any 3 BP route the natural fourth is the other Foundation. Unadvertised legal builds include 01+02+04+05 (burn with +3 Damage and 40% exposure, no mitigation), 01+02+03+04 (burst with 38% Afterburn), 06+07+08+09 (pure fortress: DDT +7, IDG +3, Lifesteal +3) and 06+07+09+10 (tank-siphon: Lifesteal +8, DDG +5, DDT +4). No-capstone hybrids such as 01+02+06+07 (+3 Damage, +4 DDT, +2 IDT/IDG/DDG) are legal; all 14 allocations are non-dominated, every node used.

Four examples are given because each capstone answers a different trait or role with its own Advanced Art: Damage (Burst), Afterburn (pressure), DDT (Defensive) and Lifesteal (sustain); the two Intent capstones are deliberately rivals. User-owned tuning left open: Supernova Unbound +3 vs +2 Damage (route +6 vs +5); Heart of the Singularity +3 vs +2 DDT (three-row route +7 vs +6); whether Light of Dead Stars should carry IDT given the burst capstone already does.
risks: Classification: no row in the kit carries an element (every damage, buff and debuff row is element-less), so no existing element can isolate it; a bloodline-keyed classification extension is required, not a bare element label. Targeting 'None' would reach every non-elemental row in the game. Collision with normal jutsu under such a label is unverified (no non-bloodline row catalog).

Resolver: under the current resolver all 10 supported rows fall back to None; nothing in this tree is reachable exclusively today. The tree assumes the proposed whole-kit classification and the bloodline-keyed label; the engine status is proposal_requires_resolver_adjustment_and_classification_extension.

Exposure breadth: both IDT rows list Bukijutsu, Genjutsu, Ninjutsu and Taijutsu with no element, so getEfficiencyRatio matches essentially every non-pierce hit the target takes from anyone for two rounds. The +5 ceiling (40% on two 40 AP casts) is therefore a team-wide amplifier, not a bloodline-only one. Pierce hits are not amplified by IDT, DDT, IDG or DDG.

Afterburn: the +10 route is one application row on a single-target 40 AP cast; its value is downstream on every non-pierce hit that one enemy takes for two rounds, capped at 60% of each hit, so other Afterburn sources saturate quickly. The kit has only one damage row of its own to feed it (Cosmic Explosion); the rest comes from weapons, normal jutsu and allies. Not simulated.

Lifesteal: the route tops out at 48%, twelve points under the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage leech budget shared with vamp; vamp from the normal tree or items can saturate the cap and waste part of the +8. It needs both combatants alive and is blocked by healprevent on the caster. The kit's own feed is one 60 AP damage row plus pierce from normal jutsu or weapons.

Ground circle: Cosmic Energy's IDG and DDT are self-targeted rows on an EMPTY_GROUND spawn, so they reach the caster only from the round after casting and only while standing on the tiles; Heart of the Singularity's +3 IDG and part of its +3 DDT are positional. No ally-hazard rows exist (the harmful rows are all SINGLE-method on OTHER_USER casts).

Stacking: BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is true at the pin, so these potency effects stack with any other potency source; the combined budget with a future normal-tree potency policy is unaudited. The bloodline IDG passive multiplies the enhanced Explosion, and 2-round DDT buffs on three 40 AP casts can be overlapped; neither was modelled.

No combat simulation: non-dominance of the 14 allocations and the row-weighted totals are arithmetic over per-row additions, not evidence of equal combat strength. The Burst route reaches one jutsu (Explosion, 60 AP) and is lowest by row weight (24), so its +6 Damage sits at the guardrail by design. Shield, Wound and move rows are unsupported. No adverse, hidden, gated or injected rows.

audit.revision: Draft 1 / Cosmic Ascendant classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.
All existing supported tags of Cosmic Ascendant jutsu inherit Cosmic Ascendant potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.
Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.
